decisions.reason: As a low-cost component that supports the installed radiant-heater base, it remains worth carrying despite weaker strategic prominence, since two years still do not provide enough adverse evidence to justify withdrawal.
As a flagship multi-model electric line in the firm's electrification strategy, its strategic option value and learning benefits make abandonment within the next year very unlikely.

Because this industrial electric hall-heater line is close to core customer needs and applications, an expanding HVAC machinery firm would normally keep backing it unless clear commercial failure emerged.

The hydrogen-capable dark-radiant line preserves a high-upside decarbonization option with strong strategic fit and low enough continuation cost, so management would keep it on the market despite ongoing market uncertainty.
